svg.title: Four matrices acting on the plane
svg.desc: Each panel shows a faint original grid, its image under the matrix, the image of the unit square in orange and the images of the two basis vectors as arrows. Stretch: det 0.75. Shear: det 1. Rotation by 30 degrees: det 1. Projection onto a line: det 0, the square collapses onto a segment.
